data.summary: Reviews show mixed authenticity. Negative reviews on Google are detailed and credible, citing specific issues with salesmanship and project management. Positive reviews are older (5-7 years) and less detailed recently. The high Yelp rating is suspicious without supporting review text. The business appears to have service quality and professionalism issues based on complaint patterns.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews from 6-7 years ago with no recent positive detail
Yelp rating high but no review text provided to assess authenticity
Limited recent review volume (only 17 on Google)
authentic_signals: Specific negative complaints with details (salesman name, subcontractor issues)
Positive reviews mention specific employees (Jarod, Jeremy) and project types (kitchen remodel, tile work)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (3.8) and Yelp (4.7). Google reviews show specific negative complaints, while Yelp rating is high but lacks review content for verification.

data.name: Blackwell's Bluewater
data.address: 6424 Lake Oaks Cir, Fort Worth, TX 76108

reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about Blackwell's and the service we received from their tech Jarod! He had amazing patience and was diligent in troubleshooting my issue with my pool's heater and totally went above-and-beyond to insure that my unit was working perfectly when he left. Blackwell's cares about their customers and that's hard to find these days.
reviews.author: Chuck Kelly

reviews.text:
Jeremy and his team have done an amazing job from the start to finish. We selected this company due to the thoroughness of the quoting process and a complete outline of completion dates and payment schedules.

He was very easy to work with and allowed my wife to have our pool remodeled into her dream. The quality and commitment to excellence are well noted and we will be using him going forward for ALL of our renovation and remodel needs.
reviews.author: Aaron Esparza

reviews.text: Blackwell's Bluewater recently managed a remodel on our kitchen in our church and they did a fantastic and professional job at every turn. Our kitchen looks more beautiful than we ever could have imagined.  Thank you for a great job.
reviews.author: Aaron Powell

reviews.text:
Jeremy Blackwell was our salesman and the most unprofessional contractor we have ever experienced.  Argumentative, disrespectful, and lack of supervision of his sub-contractors tops our list.  Buyer beware of this wolf in sheep's clothing!!
Pool design was good, Construction we would give a grade of C, and clean up was horrible!
We would not recommend Blackwell’s Bluewater pool construction.
reviews.author: Matt Pitts

reviews.text:
Thumbs up to these guys👍  I have to say they did an amazing job! I couldn’t  be happier with the work and the guys that showed up every morning, bright and early to work with the best of attitudes.
Thank you.
reviews.author: Jennifer Hutton

reviews.text: They have done a lot of tile and coping work for me in the past. The crews show up when they are supposed, do a quality job, and clean up after themselves.
reviews.author: Corey Nichols

reviews.text: made the problem worse and my son watched one of their trucks run 2 red lights while out the other day. horribly rude and sketchy people!!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: Jenny Gomes

reviews.text: Friendly, reliable, and honest service!  Our pool always looks amazing, thanks to Blackwell's Bluewater!
reviews.author: M Spurrier
